study: What topology hold-out removes - and what it does not
package: v6 compressed submission package (manuscript + SI + reproduction)

hmof.note: Fetch from the public record; verify the SHA256 before a level-3 rerun.

arcmof.note: Only topology and cluster metadata are used; no adsorption label is consumed.

environment.note: Levels 1-2 need only the Python standard library plus (for level 2) numpy and pandas. Level 3 additionally needs scikit-learn.

1_numeric.does: Rebuild every main-text and SI table number, the figure files and the cross-reference/citation map from the archived outputs.
1_numeric.does_not: No model is fitted and no raw data are read.
1_numeric.claims: All table cells and the named headline values.

2_predictions.does: Recompute MAE/R2/overlap from the archived row-level predictions (arms and screening) and compare with the archived summaries.
2_predictions.does_not: No model is fitted; the experiment-12 prediction files (npz) and the fixed-pool full score vectors are NOT in this slim archive, so those cannot be recomputed here.
2_predictions.claims: Table 2 arms, SI-C seed rows, Figure 4a-b screening overlaps, SI-F.1.

3_rerun.does: Rebuild the seed-42, 25,000-row, random-split random-forest G/B/I comparison from the public hMOF CSV and compare with the archived pooled metrics.
3_rerun.does_not: This is one representative subset, not a full-paper retrain; LOTO, the intervention arms, ARC-MOF and the follow-up experiments are not rebuilt.
3_rerun.claims: SI-I.1 / Table S19 direction (I < B < G in pooled MAE for this configuration).

result_provenance.historical: outputs/ (original analyses; included in the public v1.3 archive)
result_provenance.followup_20261023: outputs/followup_20261023/ (six follow-ups; NOT in the cited v1.3 release)
result_provenance.finish_20261023: outputs/finish_20261023/ (tie audit, candidate bootstrap, per-topology deltas; new in this revision)
result_provenance.sensitivity_mf1: reported in SI-I.7; archived with the follow-up material, not in v1.3
